dog.description_text:
Her foster writes:
Mozz is the cutest little baby who will love you with her whole heart and want to be near you and keep you company. She is truly, the cutest couch companion who will want to roll over for tummies, lay across your lap and gaze into your eyes, and snore gently on you while you work or watch tv. It took no time at all for her to decide to be your best friend.

Another foster writes:
Meet Mozz A. Rella (Mozz for short) a silly, snuggly velcro girl who's never met a stranger. Her favorite activity is to hang out on a patch of grass on a nice summer day and people watch. She loves peanut butter, squeaky toys, and pretty much any type of treat. She's great at catching things that are tossed her way and responds well to "sit" and "stay" commands.
After a careful introduction, Mozz would do great with another canine companion that matches her energy!

My foster writes: Mozz is an adopter's dream! Cannot overhype her enough! Extremely well behaved on the leash. She's calm passing fellow dogs, responding well to "wait" commands. Mozz loves watching runners and kids playing. Be prepared to make a lot of friends on your walks - Mozz is a stunner and several people will stop you to tell you so. She's a powerful presence but even little kiddos will run up to pet her.
At home her favorite place to be is attached to your hip. She won't jump on furniture if not allowed but she'll certainly keep asking to join you. (And if you do allow her to sit with you she will not accept any other position but her head on your lap.) Shes not a barker, but instead will give the true definition of puppy eyes if shes craving your attention. Big fan of kisses! Great with basic commands: sit, lay down, wait. She's learning to take treats softly. She's been left alone for up to 10 hours without any destruction. 10/10 recommend.

Meet Mozz!

Mozz came to ACC after her owner passed away, and while her past is unknown, she's shown herself to be a social, playful, and people-oriented dog who enjoys attention and treats. She's a happy greeter who leans into interactions and is eager to engage with handlers.

My Ideal Home

Mozz would do well in an active, structured home that can continue teaching her polite manners and impulse control in a positive, consistent way. She thrives with engagement, training, and clear boundaries, especially around excitement and food rewards.

Good with Other Pets?

Mozz ignores other dogs in leash observations. Slow and careful introductions with resident pets are always recommended.

Good with Kids?

Due to her mouthiness and high arousal when taking treats, Mozz is recommended for a home without young children under 5. She may be open to older, respectful children after a meet.

Things to Know

Mozz is an affectionate, playful dog who gets very excited during interaction and can jump up frequently when seeking attention or treats. She takes treats with a very hard mouth at times, so continued positive reinforcement training around impulse control and gentle mouth behavior is important. She is otherwise tolerant of handling, enjoys engagement, and walks nicely on leash with only mild pulling. With consistency and structure, Mozz has strong potential to channel her enthusiasm into great manners and reliable behavior.

Fun Fact

Mozz is the kind of dog who always shows up with enthusiasm. She just needs a little guidance to make sure all that excitement turns into good manners.
